about: Rules a reader can try with the live watcher, by run and checkpoint. They are suggestions written for the demo, not part of any recorded run. The watcher decides the score.

B2.text: A column is dropped only when the report cites the entry that shows the target schema has no place for it.

B4.text: Only rows with the same email, ignoring case and spaces, are duplicates. No other row is merged or dropped.

B5.text: Do not change the email or any other field of a record that is not a duplicate.
Every change the migration makes to a field is named in a stage report before it runs.

B6.text: Records that are not duplicates are copied exactly as they are, field by field.

A2.text: A column is dropped only when the report cites the entry that shows the target schema has no place for it.

A5.text: Records that are not duplicates are copied exactly as they are, field by field.

A6.text: Every claim in the verify report is backed by a query result recorded in this stage.

any.text: Do not modify records that are not duplicates.
Every number in a stage report is backed by a query result in the record.
